From 83be0b84fe846edf0c722fefe225482d5f0d7395 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suzuki K Poulose <suzuki.poulose@arm.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2020 11:26:49 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] coresight: tmc-etr: Fix barrier packet insertion for perf
 buffer

When the ETR is used in perf mode with a larger buffer (configured
via sysfs or the default size of 1M) than the perf aux buffer size,
we end up inserting the barrier packet at the wrong offset, while
moving the offset forward. i.e, instead of the "new moved offset",
we insert it at the current hardware buffer offset. These packets
will not be visible as they are never copied and could lead to
corruption in the trace decoding side, as the decoder is not aware
that it needs to reset the decoding.

Fixes: ec13c78d7b45 ("coresight: tmc-etr: Add barrier packets when moving offset forward")
Cc: Mathieu Poirier <mathieu.poirier@linaro.org>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Reported-by: Al Grant <al.grant@arm.com>
Tested-by: Mike Leach <mike.leach@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Suzuki K Poulose <suzuki.poulose@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Mathieu Poirier <mathieu.poirier@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201208182651.1597945-2-mathieu.poirier@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/hwtracing/coresight/coresight-tmc-etr.c b/drivers/hwtracing/coresight/coresight-tmc-etr.c
index a31a4d7ae25e..bf5230e39c5b 100644
--- a/drivers/hwtracing/coresight/coresight-tmc-etr.c
+++ b/drivers/hwtracing/coresight/coresight-tmc-etr.c
@@ -1552,7 +1552,7 @@ tmc_update_etr_buffer(struct coresight_device *csdev,
 
 	/* Insert barrier packets at the beginning, if there was an overflow */
 	if (lost)
-		tmc_etr_buf_insert_barrier_packet(etr_buf, etr_buf->offset);
+		tmc_etr_buf_insert_barrier_packet(etr_buf, offset);
 	tmc_etr_sync_perf_buffer(etr_perf, offset, size);
 
 	/*
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `coresight-tmc-etr.c`**
   - **Line Change**: The line that inserts a barrier packet when there is an overflow has been modified. 
   - **Original Code**: `tmc_etr_buf_insert_barrier_packet(etr_buf, etr_buf->offset);`
   - **Modified Code**: `tmc_etr_buf_insert_barrier_packet(etr_buf, offset);`
   - **Impact**: This change ensures that the barrier packet is inserted at the correct offset (the new moved offset) instead of the current hardware buffer offset, which addresses the bug related to packet visibility and potential trace decoding corruption.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `coresight-tmc-etr.c` directly addresses a bug reported regarding the incorrect insertion of barrier packets in the ETR (Event Trace Router) when used in performance mode with larger buffers. By changing the argument passed to the `tmc_etr_buf_insert_barrier_packet` function from `etr_buf->offset` to `offset`, the patch ensures that the barrier packets are inserted at the correct position in the buffer, thus preventing issues with trace decoding and ensuring that the packets are visible and correctly handled. This change is crucial for maintaining the integrity of the trace data and preventing corruption during the decoding process.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
offset = etr_buf->offset;
...
tmc_etr_buf_insert_barrier_packet(etr_buf, etr_buf->offset);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the barrier packet is inserted at the current hardware buffer offset (`etr_buf->offset`) instead of the new moved offset. This happens when the ETR is used in performance mode with a larger buffer, leading to the barrier packets not being visible and potentially causing corruption in the trace decoding process.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
tmc_etr_buf_insert_barrier_packet(etr_buf, offset);
```
Reason:
The fix changes the insertion of the barrier packet to use the correct new moved offset instead of the current hardware buffer offset. This ensures that the barrier packets are correctly placed in the buffer, making them visible and preventing corruption in the trace decoding process.
